title: PolicyHandshake
description: The two messages that open a policy worker session (ADR-010 §2, ADR-008 §3). The client sends hello with the contracts it speaks; the worker answers ready with its own set plus its encoder version, the hash of the engine-data table it was built with and the ids of the checkpoints it loaded. Any difference refuses the session before a battle starts.

ContractVersion.description: One contract the two sides must agree on: its name, schema_version and the SHA-256 of its schema file's JCS bytes.

schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the contract schema's JCS bytes: lowercase hex.

Checkpoint.description: A loaded checkpoint: its role and id (the SHA-256 of its safetensors file bytes).

Hello.description: Client to worker: the contracts the client speaks.

contracts.description: Sorted by name, no name twice (a reader rule).

Ready.description: Worker to client: its contracts and what it loaded.

contracts.description: Sorted by name, no name twice (a reader rule).

encoder_version.description: The encoder the worker reads observations with.

engine_data_hash.description: SHA-256 of the engine-data table (EngineData JCS bytes) the encoder's vocabularies come from.

checkpoints.description: Sorted by role, each role once (a reader rule).
